after.zh: 你搭出了 Harris 角点检测：两个方向的变化都大，才是角。直边只有一个方向大，所以 det 小、R 为负。
after.en: You have built the Harris corner detector: it is a corner only when the change is large in both directions. A straight edge is large in only one direction, so det is small and R is negative.

t.zh: 手机拍全景时，要在相邻两张照片里认出同一个点，才能把它们拼齐。可不是每个点都好认：白墙上随便一点，换到墙上别处看起来也一样。
t.en: When a phone shoots a panorama, it has to recognise the same point in two neighbouring photos to line them up. But not every point is easy to recognise: any spot on a white wall looks just like any other spot on it.

t.zh: 这一章要回答：哪些点容易再找到？先比一比平坦处、直边、角这三种地方，想想各自是什么让它好认，或者难认。
t.en: This chapter asks: which points are easy to find again? Start by comparing three kinds of place, flat areas, straight edges and corners, and think about what makes each one easy or hard to recognise.

t.zh: Sobel x、Sobel y 你见过，分别量左右和上下方向的变化。<part-ref to="part:arith"></part-ref>选 ×，就把两张图逐格相乘。
t.en: You have met Sobel x and Sobel y: they measure change left-to-right and top-to-bottom. Set <part-ref to="part:arith"></part-ref> to × and it multiplies two images pixel by pixel.

t.zh: 测试有一个角、一个方块、一条直边和字母 L。角上输出 1，直边和平坦处都输出 0。少数格子出错可以接受。
t.en: The tests are a corner, a square, a straight edge and the letter L. Output 1 on corners and 0 on straight edges and flat areas. A few wrong pixels are fine.

caption.en: A corner: only the corner itself is 1

brief.zh: 只在角上输出 1。直边、平坦处都是 0。
brief.en: Output 1 only at corners. Straight edges and flat areas are 0.

hint.zh: 在角上，往哪个方向挪都会变；在直边上，沿着边挪不会变。分别统计 Gx²、Gy²、Gx·Gy 在 3×3 窗口里的和，再算 det − 0.05·trace²。
hint.en: At a corner, moving in any direction changes what you see; on a straight edge, moving along the edge changes nothing. Sum Gx², Gy² and Gx·Gy over a 3×3 window, then compute det − 0.05·trace².
